notes.title: Night Crisis Update (5/2/2019)
notes.notes:
Hello!


Here is a quick update on the game and whats coming *Hopefully* in Early June 

I re calibrated  the recommend settings , because the game requires 16gb of ram ,so this solves the crashes and studder some players were getting. My rig has 16gb of ram thats why I wasn't able to reproduce the crashes.



Story Mode ( 3 playable missions) 
Player controlled Jets ( bot jets are already in) 
2 PvP Modes ( commander and Hardpoint)
 3 new maps
 achievements 
 2+ dozen more bugs fixes / improvements


When we are sure that this patch is ready , I will post a teaser post showing media of the update.

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
Hello again! Here we are with patch 1.4!


 Game mode objectives now show every time you deploy
 Hydra rocket explosion issue is now fixed
 audio going in and out with vehicles - fixed
 AHz1 pilot now has better vision
 Adjusted motion blur 
 Reduced spread and recoil when aiming for all weapons
 Reload sound for enemy soldier volume lowered
 Explosive gadgets not awarding kill - fixed
 Removed kill streak glitch 
 RPG launchers stopping mid air glitch - fixed
 Weapon idle stretch animation while aiming - fixed
 Domination area UI  mesh issue - fixed
 Added Boat Wake for player and AI boats
 AI truck long distance sound issue - fixed
 Another 15% performance improvement on SND and Domination 
 Performance issue when dying by a explosion - fixed
 Added UI HUD for enemy jets to make them easier to spot
 Changed spawn button from "Assault" to "Deploy" on Ruins
 Fixed domination objects not showing on Oil RIG map
 Menu typo on Oil Rig map addressed
 Added spawn protection for 4sec 


Good luck playing! If you have any questions, feedback or suggestions post them in our community forum!

notes.title: Patch 1.3

 Fixed wave game mode issue on the oil rig 
 Fixed Culling issue with helicopters 
 Fixed Main menu background issue 
 Removed GDOC watermark
 Fixed NPC truck audio server issue 
Mesh collier added on Ship on island map
 AI jet Issue on island map
add notification to hold breath when using long range  scopes 
removed bipod notification
Fixed Tow missile and other issues with attackboat 
No bullet spread when using burst mode

If you have any other questions, feedback or suggestions feel free to write them on our forums! We always read them and take into account.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello gamers! We've further addressed issues withing the game and here is patch 1.2.

 weapons sway issue at the start - fixed
 reload animation looping while in pause menu - fixed
 20% better performance optimization for SND and Domination modes
 tank seat swapping issue was fixed
 nerfed AI rockets even more 


We listen to our community, if you got any other questions, feedback or suggestions feel free to submit them into our game forum, we read them all

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Good day everyone! Patch 1.1 has arrived!

We listen to our community and we took your opinions into account and addressed issues

Changelog:

 AI Rockets have been nerfed 
 Performance boosted by ~50%
 Addressed music and quit button issues
 Addressed game crashing
 No longer dying while parachuting
 Improved menu loading times 
 Set default controls for switching weapons 
 Constant breathing sound effect - fixed
 bipod key glitch (canelled feature) - fixed
 Weapon and gadget tutorials blocking vision - fixed
 Reduced shaking when aiming down sights
 Bullet cams not dealing death - fixed 
 Choosing no class and spawning with character and taking no damage - fixed
 Reduced drone speed
 Improved vision while in vehicle
 Switch seat input issue - fixed
 Minimap blocking chat - fixed 
 Menu text typos - fixed


If you got any other questions, feedback or suggestions feel free to post them in our forums.

notes.notes:
